messages:
sre-bot: Pager: billing_alert - spikes in overage flags detected in prod-us-west. metric=billing.overage_flags rate +420% (5m). dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/9876
marco (oncall): ack - I'm on it. any evidence of customer-facing invoices yet?
elaine (billing): seeing large token-count deltas in ingest. sample quick query below shows ~2x tokens for several customers vs baseline. preliminary looks like double-emits into metering.
elaine (billing): ```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) AS tk
FROM metering.events
WHERE time > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tk DESC
LIMIT 5;
-- acct-phi: 1,120,542 tokens (baseline ~520k)
```
teo (infra): recent deploy: emitter-v2 (retry/backoff) rolled 12m ago to prod-us-west. could be duplicate delivery on transient errors. logs show repeated POSTs to /emit with same trace_id sometimes.
jess (cs): we already have one customer DM'ing billing that their usage spike email arrived. pinged them to hold while we investigate.
marco (oncall): immediate plan: 1) mute noisy overage alert for 10m to stop pager churn, 2) scope whether counts are duplicates vs real, 3) if dup emits, roll back emitter-v2 and route to emitter-v1.
marco (oncall): @teo can you confirm how quickly we can rollback emitter?
teo (infra): rolling undo now.
teo (infra): ```bash
kubectl -n metering rollout undo deployment/emitter-v2 --to-revision=1
# pods scaling, should be <2m
```
teo (infra): rollback initiated, scaling emitter-v2 -> 0, traffic will shift to emitter-v1.
elaine (billing): starting a short reconciliation job to mark likely-duplicate events and exclude from billing pipeline until backfill run. running a sampling job now.
elaine (billing): sample output showing duplicate trace ids: ```
trace_id: 8a7f-... count: 3 -> events: [emit, retry, emit]
```
liam (eng): if duplicates are in the ingest queue, do we need to purge or dedupe at consumer? I can patch dedupe window to 10s for metering-processor.
marco (oncall): go for it, liam. prioritize low-risk change. also create customer credit plan in case invoices already queued.
liam (eng): opening PR for dedupe window (small hotfix).
jess (cs): drafting comms: short note to affected customers offering hold on billing + proactive credit if invoices already created. will post draft in #customer-success for review.
elaine (billing): reconciliation script identifies ~95% of the surge as dup-emits (same request_id within 2m window). will generate a false-positive list to prevent charge.
sre-bot: Incident severity -> P1 (billing) per runbook. sleuth oncall: marco (incident-commander).
teo (infra): rollback completed. emitter-v1 handling traffic. metrics look flattening in the last 2m.
marco (oncall): monitoring: billing.overage_flags down to +18% vs baseline. still above normal but trending.
liam (eng): dedupe hotfix merged & applied to processor canary (1/3). no errors so far.
elaine (billing): started backfill job to correct metering ledger - will tag corrected entries and emit a report. ETA ~45m for full backfill for last 24h window.
jess (cs): sent provisional comms to 3 affected customers asking to hold while backfill completes, offering credits.
marco (oncall): handing off followup to liam in 30m for backfill monitoring. I'll keep incident open until ledger reconciled. any objections?
liam (eng): taking followup. noted.
marco (oncall): final for now - monitor for any residual overage emails and pause billing pipeline output if anomalies resurface. closing pager but keeping thread live. :white_check_mark:
